item.title: Overgrown shrubs, 27th September
item.description:

Several of the shrubs are very overgrown making it unsafe to cycle or see other cyclists walkers coming towards you. The briars are creeping across the pathway and we continually experience punctures. There are also several areas where the tarmac has dropped which could cause a hazard to cyclists in the same area between CMW and the old pumping station.
